calls.title: Jun 24, 10:09 AM
calls.summary: The discussion focused on implementing a centralized experimentation model using GrowthBook to manage over 15 brands. This approach utilizes a shared Snowflake data source to create a single source of truth for key metrics, allowing brands to conduct their experiments while benefiting from shared learnings. Experimentation depths include testing algorithms and UI variants, with advanced statistical analysis powering cross-platform execution in eight countries. The pricing model offers group-level discounts, and there’s a structured onboarding plan prioritizing smaller brands for initial testing. Future discussions will include establishing legal contracts and refining workflows for ongoing collaboration.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, experimentation, Snowflake, personalization, metrics, commercial proposal
